title: Find the full names of all superheroes who have blue eyes and more than 12
question: Find the full names of all superheroes who have blue eyes and more than 12 superpowers, and calculate what percentage they represent among all superheroes with blue eyes.

prediction.sql:
WITH BlueEyeHeroes AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS HeroID, s.XCL_020 AS FullName
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN colour AS c ON s.XCL_022 = c.XCL_005
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = 'Blue'
),
HeroPowerCounts AS (
    SELECT s.XCL_018 AS HeroID, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.XCL_013) AS PowerCount
    FROM superhero AS s
    INNER JOIN hero_power AS hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    GROUP BY s.XCL_018
),
QualifyingHeroes AS (
    SELECT b.HeroID, b.FullName
    FROM BlueEyeHeroes AS b
    INNER JOIN HeroPowerCounts AS hpc ON b.HeroID = hpc.HeroID
    WHERE hpc.PowerCount > 12
)
SELECT q.FullName,
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QualifyingHeroes) AS REAL) * 100 / 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BlueEyeHeroes) AS Percentage
FROM QualifyingHeroes AS q

),
HeroPowerCounts AS (

),
QualifyingHeroes AS (
    SELECT b.HeroID, b.FullName

)
SELECT q.FullName,
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QualifyingHeroes) AS REAL) * 100 / 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BlueEyeHeroes) AS Percentage
FROM QualifyingHeroes AS q
